03-split-live.html.note: Implemented as a dependency-free static site under docs/ (GitHub Pages from the branch): docs/index.html + docs/style.css + docs/app.js, with velo's own factory palette as the token source and --dim lifted to #9aa3ae to pass AA for body text. One deliberate deviation from the artboard: the archives CI publishes are named velo-<tag>-<target>.tar.gz, so there is no tag-free /releases/latest/download/ URL; the platform picker now shows the exact file name to look for, Releases is the way in, and the copyable one-liner is the source build. Verified: 200/200/200 from a local server, no remote asset loads, local references resolve, the four targets match .github/workflows/release.yml, node --check clean, reduced-motion honoured.
